proposals.before: On rennwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager.
proposals.after: On renwu day the new Emperor honored his mother, Lady Xiao, as Empress Dowager.
proposals.reason: Chinese 壬午 is renwu; 'rennwu' is a misspelling of the sexagenary day name.

proposals.before: On rennwu day, honored mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager.
proposals.after: On renwu day, honored mother Lady Xiao as Empress Dowager.
proposals.reason: Chinese 壬午 is renwu; 'rennwu' is a misspelling of the sexagenary day name.

proposals.before: On renshen day the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her.
proposals.after: On renshen day the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and she was also ordered to bow to them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 亦命拜之 most naturally means aowei Lady Xiao was also ordered to bow to the spirit tablets, not that the emperor was ordered to bow to her.

proposals.before: On renshen day, the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and he was also ordered to bow to her.
proposals.after: On renshen day, the Emperor visited the spirit tablet tent; at that time aowei Lady Xiao had just entered the palace, and she was also ordered to bow to them.
proposals.reason: Chinese 亦命拜之 refers to ordering aowei Lady Xiao to bow; English wrongly makes the emperor the ordered subject.

proposals.before: In the first year of Chongqing, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
proposals.after: In the first year of Chongxi, on the renshen new moon of the first spring month the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
proposals.reason: Chinese 重熙 is Chongxi, not Chongqing; the era name is mistranslated.

proposals.before: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongqing.
proposals.after: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Chongxi.
proposals.reason: Chinese 重熙 is Chongxi, not Chongqing.

proposals.before: General amnesty; changed era name to Chongqing.
proposals.after: General amnesty; changed era name to Chongxi.
proposals.reason: Chinese 重熙 is Chongxi, not Chongqing.

proposals.before: In the first year of Chongqing, spring, first month, on the renshen new moon, the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
proposals.after: In the first year of Chongxi, spring, first month, on the renshen new moon, the Empress Dowager held court at the main hall and received obeisance from the Emperor and ministers.
proposals.reason: Chinese 重熙 is Chongxi, not Chongqing.

proposals.before: Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong was appointed Associate Councilor of State.
proposals.after: Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhan was appointed Associate Councilor.
proposals.reason: Chinese 耶律求翰同平章事 means Yelü Qiuhan was appointed tong pingzhangshi; the English wrongly fused 同 into the personal name as Qiuhantong.

proposals.before: Made Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhantong Associate Councilor of State.
proposals.after: Made Northern Great King Yelü Qiuhan Associate Councilor.
proposals.reason: Chinese separates the person 耶律求翰 from the office 同平章事; literal fused them.

proposals.before: On renchen day Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute.
proposals.after: On renchen day Jurchen xiangwen Taiya led his followers to come with tribute.
proposals.reason: Chinese 臺押率所部 means Taiya led his subordinates; English wrongly fused 率 into the personal name as Taiyashuai.

proposals.before: On renchen day, Jurchen xiangwen Taiyashuai came with his followers to pay tribute.
proposals.after: On renchen day, Jurchen xiangwen Taiya led his troops to come with tribute.
proposals.reason: Chinese 率所部 is a verb phrase 'led his troops', not part of the name.
